parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units from compound_structures joined to molecule_dictionary on molregno, joined to activities on molregno, joined to assays on assay_id. Filter assays by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3885862'. Filter activities where standard_relation = '=' and standard_value is not null. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
